page.overview:
Who is Young Man?

The Young Man is a minor antagonist in Invincible, debuting in Season 1 and later reappears in Season 3 as the bully of Oliver Grayson.

The young man appeared when Titan was here slaughting everyone else. He was spared by the Titan but accidentally pulled a trigger but he still lets him live, the young man runs away.
